JSON formatter

Format, validate and minify JSON while preserving large-number digits.

Your result will appear here.

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Paste JSON and choose Format or Minify. The browser validates syntax, then a token-preserving formatter changes whitespace only outside strings. Large numbers, decimal notation, escape sequences, property order and duplicate keys are retained. The output does not depend on JavaScript’s rounded numeric values.

Try this example

The identifier 9007199254740993123 remains exactly 9007199254740993123 in the output.

How your data is handled ↗Format JSON without rounding large numbers ↗

Good to know

Are large numbers and duplicate keys preserved?

Yes. Number tokens and key order are preserved, including repeated keys. Repeated keys can still be interpreted differently by downstream software. Standard JSON comments and trailing commas are rejected; files above 2 MB are not supported.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
